description_short: Summarize semiconductor ALE processes from Sang & Chang Table 1 by activation type and modification/removal chemistry, counting how many distinct semiconductors use each combination.

paper.title: Physical and chemical effects in directional atomic layer etching

tables_modeled.label: Table 1
tables_modeled.description: Summary of directional semiconductor ALE processes: semiconductor, surface modification chemistry, removal chemistry, and activation type.

properties_used.label: Semiconductor
properties_used.role: Identifies the semiconductor material being etched (e.g., Si, SiO2, Si3N4, III–V).

properties_used.label: Modification
properties_used.role: Describes the surface-modification (adsorption) chemistry used in the first ALE step.

properties_used.label: Removal
properties_used.role: Describes the removal / desorption chemistry used to remove the modified surface layer.

properties_used.label: Activation
properties_used.role: Specifies the activation mode (e.g., ion bombardment, neutral beam, photon/thermal) that drives the ALE process.

aggregation.description: Rows are grouped by activation type and modification/removal pair; the query counts distinct semiconductors per group.

columns: activation: activation mode label (e.g., ion-bombardment-assisted, neutral-beam-assisted).
n_semiconductors: number of distinct semiconductor materials for which this combination is reported.

postprocessing_notes.interpretation: The result highlights which activation pathways and chemistries are used across multiple semiconductor ALE systems, helping to identify dominant strategies in directional ALE.
